text:
maria: Heads-up — spotted a spike in `PodPending` for model-serve-prod and batch-embed in eu-west around 07:10 UTC. CAScaled down several GPU nodes and now pods are stuck unschedulable :thinking:

aj: saw the same. CA decided to drain 3 g4dn pools. Logs show nodes fell below utilization threshold then drain started.

maria: Does anyone have quick ideas which flags we should tweak? It looks like short-lived prefix-cache churn caused utilization to appear low.

aj: my 2c: increase `--scale-down-unneeded-time`, raise `--scale-down-utilization-threshold`, and switch expander away from `binpack` for GPU pools. Example we could try: 

```
--scale-down-unneeded-time=15m
--scale-down-utilization-threshold=0.25
--expander=least-waste
--balance-similar-node-groups=true
```

aj: also consider adding `--ok-total-unready-count`/`--ok-total-unready-percentage` so node drain doesn't trigger during transient network blips.

sophie: agree. For GPU nodepools we want conservative scale-down because pods are expensive to reschedule (cold GPU image pulls, model caches). Also, ensure NodeAffinity/taints are correct so non-GPU workloads don't land on GPUs and fool the CA.

maria: model-serve pods currently have no `nodeSelector` — they rely on resource requests for scheduling. That made CA think nodes were underutilized when most traffic was KV-cache warmups. We should be explicit.

ben: here's a short toleration/selector snippet we can add to the deployment to make scheduling and scaling behaviour deterministic:

```
nodeSelector:
  redwood.com/gpu: "true"
tolerations:
- key: "redwood.com/gpu"
  operator: "Equal"
  value: "true"
  effect: "NoSchedule"
```

ben: With that, CA won't be confused by pods landing on mixed pools.

maria: good. Also noticed the expander used for the region is `most-pods` currently (kube-autoscaler config). That encourages fewer nodes but increases churn when pods are bursty. For GPU we probably want `least-waste` or `priority` so we avoid aggressive consolidation.

aj: agree. Another leaky point: `skip-nodes-with-local-storage` was true; that prevented CA from considering some evictable nodes. We should keep it `true` for general pools but `false` for gpu pools? tricky. Maybe set `--skip-nodes-with-local-storage=false` on gpu-autoscaler instance and leave default elsewhere.

infra-bot: cluster-autoscaler (eu-west-1) restarted at 1738456000 due to OOM; previous run had scale-down attempts at 07:08 and 07:09 UTC.

sophie: OOM restarts are noise — but if CA restarts during scale-down it can leave nodes in draining state. We should bump CA memory and add a restart backoff alert.

maria: Ops plan: 1) add nodeSelector/toleration to model-serve and batch-embed (canary), 2) change gpu-autoscaler flags to `--scale-down-unneeded-time=15m --scale-down-utilization-threshold=0.25 --expander=least-waste --skip-nodes-with-local-storage=false` for 24h canary, 3) increase CA mem for eu-west and add alert for repeated restarts.

aj: I'll open a quick PR to infra repo with the CA flags and update kustomize for the gpu-autoscaler helmvalues.

ben: I'll send a tiny patch for the deployments to add nodeSelector/toleration and create a rollout plan (canary half the replicas).

sophie: I'll wire a grafana dashboard panel and alert: `CA-scale-down-throttle` when scale-downs > 3 in 5m and `PodPending-GPU` when >5 pods pending for 10m in a pool.

maria: thanks. Let's run the canary for 24h, then re-evaluate cost impact. If utilization stays low we can dial down later. :thumbsup:

aj: FYI cost note — increasing utilization threshold will keep more nodes up, ~+8–12% GPU spend in worst-case for eu-west. We should quantify with last 7d pod histograms.

maria: yes please add the cost delta to the PR description.

infra-bot: alert raised: `cluster-autoscaler-restart-eu-west` at 1738456450 (1 restart in 10m).

ben: I'll shepherd the PRs and coordinate the canary window.

maria: great — ping here once both PRs are live and I'll monitor the pending pods metric and estimator.

sophie: pushing the grafana panels now, ETA 30m.

aj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412 — contains CA flags and notes.

maria: awesome — thanks everyone. We'll reconvene if pending doesn't drop within 30m after the canary flips.

ben: noted.

sophie: leaving a quick runbook note in #incidents in case this recurs.

maria: closing loop — will post the final numbers in ~24h.
